criteria.description: Calendar helper creates an event (title, start, end, timezone, optional description/location/attendees) on the selected account's calendar via one command, returning the event id
criteria.evidence: WP02 scripts/google/calendar_helper.py `create` (payload-file + explicit modes); tests/google/test_calendar_helper.py (45 pass, 100% branch cov) assert the Google event body mapping and returned event_id. sendUpdates=none default; attendees suppressed on inbox path.
criteria.notes: Live create on kentgale@gmail.com confirmed at office2 deploy (SC-001).

criteria.description: Helper lists/finds events in a time window returning id/title/start/end
criteria.evidence: WP02 `list` subcommand; concrete schema {status,count,events:[{event_id,summary,start,end,recurring}]}; empty window = count 0 (not an error). Covered in test_calendar_helper.py.

criteria.description: Helper updates an existing event's mutable fields by id
criteria.evidence: WP02 `update` get-then-patch + --clear; single-occurrence recurring -> recurrence_scope_unsupported (exit 2); missing id -> not_found (exit 1). Covered in test_calendar_helper.py.

criteria.description: Helper deletes/cancels an existing event by id
criteria.evidence: WP02 `delete` (--send-updates default none); missing id -> not_found (exit 1). Covered in test_calendar_helper.py.

criteria.description: Account selected by --account (default personal); per-account credential store; a new account needs only new credentials, no code change
criteria.evidence: WP01 scripts/google/calendar_auth.py per-account resolution (FELIX_GOOGLE_DIR/<account>) + charset guard; WP02 --account flag default personal. tests/google/test_calendar_auth.py (28 pass) cover path resolution + a second account name resolving to its own dir.
criteria.notes: SC-005: adding intentional account = drop creds, no code change.

criteria.description: Auth loads+auto-refreshes; on any auth failure fails safe (clear error, non-zero, no mutation, no fallback)
criteria.evidence: WP01 typed CalendarAuthError (no interactive consent path — asserted by an exploding-flow stub); WP02 catches it -> exit 3 with ERROR: auth_failed + SUMMARY status=auth_failed and ZERO recorded API calls on create/self-check auth-fail paths. Auth resolved before any mutation (_build_service before handlers).

criteria.description: Helper conforms to the project CLI contract: subcommands, documented exit codes, SUMMARY: stdout line
criteria.evidence: WP02 argparse subcommands + exit-code map (0/1/2/3); --json on a preceding line, SUMMARY: always the final stdout line (parametrized invariant test). Matches docs/design/helper-script-conventions.md.

criteria.description: Inbox capture reaches the calendar via a deterministic helper call (no agent-to-agent delegation); an inbox calendar-intent note creates an event end-to-end (closes #679)
criteria.evidence: WP03 scripts/inbox/route_calendar_event.py --create (validate -> build envelope -> invoke helper -> emit status); capture calendar step is a SINGLE command with NO openclaw agent/sessions_send hop (reviewer-confirmed); tests/inbox/test_route_calendar_event.py cover created/needs_clarification/error with helper mocked. Never fakes a created event (#683).
criteria.notes: Code-complete; live end-to-end (SC-002) confirmed at office2 deploy, then GitHub #679 closed.
